questions: def:singular_manifold_endowed_causal (l.2319) says 'causally connected': for x ≤ y there is a future causal path from x to y. It is read here as lean-causal's Causal.Causality.CausallyArcConnected (DEC-33), which is stronger: in every open U, x ≤_U y and x ≪_U y are realised by causal / chronal curves of U, not only x ≤ y in M by some causal path. The stronger reading is what the model satisfies and what the manifold case will inherit; does the author accept it as the reading of the definition (the paper's weaker form follows at U = M)?

Along ≼ in E0, dist x y ≤ 3(τ_y − τ_x) (GX.E0.Le.dist_le): it gives at once strong causality (J⁺(B) ∩ J⁻(B) for a small ball B), convergence of causal curves with bounded τ (GX.E0.exists_tendsto_of_bddAbove/Below), and diamonds a basis.

A Cauchy surface near a BTZ point: the level {h = c} of N = {f > a, h < b, r < 2(c − a)/3} (GX.E0.sliceDom, isCauchySurfaceOn_sliceDom). The r-wall is chosen so that below the level it is out of reach (r = 2(h − f)/3) and the f-wall so that above the level it is (f = h − 3r/2); then Causal.Causality.{past,future}Extensible_of_tendsto_opens (Causal.Flat.Cosmological) close the argument with E0's closed J^±, strong causality, arc-connectedness and causality. The product N = {f > a} ∩ {h < b} fails (past curves exit through f = a above the level).
A homeomorphism of E0 preserving Le and Lt both ways is a Causal.ChartIso of E0's causality (GX.E0.chartIso_of_homeo): rotations and τ-translations (tauShift, rotE0).
In E0 h = τ + r is a continuous time function strictly increasing along ≤ (GX.E0.hcoord_lt_of_le): CurvesExtend, causality, and uniqueness of the meeting point with any level of h follow.

Causal.ChartIso is local for absolutely minimal causalities: GX.E0.chartIso_of_isoNear (isoNear at every source point ⇒ ChartIso), with GX.E0.IsoNear's calculus (mono, congr, trans, symm) — the way to prove chartIso_mem for any a.e.-isomorphism groupoid.

A homeomorphism that is a causal isomorphism off a lightlike BTZ line and maps the line to itself is a causal isomorphism (GX.E0.chartIso_of_axis): no rigidity needed; the orientation along the line comes from a chronological ray and closed J^± (GX.E0.orientation_axis).
